description: Runs the three-question FHA multifamily program chooser from fhamultifamily.loan/chooser: returns the likely program (223(f), 221(d)(4) new construction or substantial rehab, 223(a)(7), 241(a), or "not FHA yet"), the reason, and the program page to read next.

built.description: Only when has_fha_loan is false: is the property built and operating (false = land or a construction project)? Default true.

condition.description: Only when has_fha_loan is false and built is true. heavy_renovation means more than about $55,096 a unit of work. Default stabilized_3_plus_years.

has_fha_loan.description: Does the property already have an FHA-insured mortgage?

need.description: Only when has_fha_loan is true: what the owner needs. Default lower_rate_no_cash_out.

name: choose_program
title: Which FHA multifamily program fits

annotations.title: 2026 FHA multifamily limits, ratios, MIP and fees

description: HUD's 2026 FHA multifamily rulebook as the site publishes it: per-unit statutory limits by bedroom (Section 207/223(f)/220, 221(d)(4) or 231; elevator and non-elevator) with the high-cost amount for a state, loan-to-value and coverage ratios by tier, large-loan ratios, MIP, HUD fees and loan terms, each with its source.

section.description: Limits table: 207_223f_220 (Section 207, 207 pursuant to 223(f), and 220), 221d4, or 231. Default 207_223f_220.

state.description: Optional two-letter state code, to apply its high-cost percentage (405% in AK, HI, GU, VI; 270% elsewhere).

name: get_limits_and_costs
title: 2026 FHA multifamily limits, ratios, MIP and fees

description: Estimates the maximum FHA 223(f) or 221(d)(4) loan the way HUD Form 92264-A does, with the fhamultifamily.loan sizer: statutory limit (2026 per-unit limits x high-cost %), loan to value or cost, debt service coverage with 0.25% MIP, the 223(f) cash-out or acquisition test, large-loan ratios at $130M+. Returns each test, the one that controls, payment, MIP, fees, DSCR and LTV.

build_months.description: 221(d)(4) only: construction period in months, for the upfront MIP. Default 20 (the sizer page default).

elevator.description: Elevator building (higher per-unit limits). Default false.

noi.description: Underwritten annual net operating income in dollars.

payoff.description: 223f_refinance only: existing debt plus closing costs, for the cash-out test.

price.description: 223f_purchase only: price plus repairs and closing costs, for the acquisition cost test.

rate.description: Note rate in percent. Default 5.54, the median note rate on apartment loans HUD endorsed in the year to September 30, 2026 (not a quote).

state.description: Two-letter state or territory code, e.g. TX. AK, HI, GU and VI use the 405% high-cost percentage; all others 270%.

tier.description: Rents: market (87% / 1.15), affordable (tax credit or Section 8 rents at least 10% below market), assisted (90%+ of units with rental assistance), middle (221(d)(4) only; on 223(f) it sizes as market). Default market.

units.description: Unit count by bedroom, e.g. {"br1": 48, "br2": 60, "br3": 12}. Keys: studio, br1, br2, br3, br4 (four or more bedrooms). Omitted keys are 0.

value.description: 223(f): property (or appraised) value in dollars. 221(d)(4): total replacement cost in dollars.

name: size_loan
title: Size an FHA 223(f) or 221(d)(4) loan
